---
title: "Coxcomb (polar bars)"
description: "Bars mapped into polar space — a Nightingale-style coxcomb via coord_polar()."
categories: [Polar]
---

```{r}
#| include: false
source("_helper.R")
```

Coordinate systems apply after the marks are built. Draw bars, then bend the
space with `coord_polar()`.

```{r}
p <- vplot(mtcars) |>
  mark_bar(x = factor(cyl), fill = factor(cyl)) |>
  coord_polar(theta = "x") |>
  labs(title = "Coxcomb (bars in polar space)", fill = "cyl")
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
vg(p, "coxcomb")
```
